note: On the west shore of Lake Bomoseen near Glen Lake, with a sandy beach, snack bar, boat launch and canoe, kayak, rowboat and pedal-boat rentals; a trail links to Half Moon Pond State Park. --Claude
summary: Park page + RA site list + 2026 map: season Memorial Day Fri-Labor Day (05-22/09-07 replaces derived 05-20/09-07); 55 tent/RV (stored 64 counted lean-tos), 42 RV-capable, max 35, 14 sites 28 ft+; no hookups; flush toilets, token showers, dump, water.
